text:
maya: Heads-up — we've got oscillating perplexity on Mixtral-8x at longctx (16k) when RoPE=NTK and KV eviction is enabled. Seen this across two clusters.
liam: Repro steps? quick summary pls
maya: Small prompt drift test: run eval set A (news prefix 2k) -> perplexity stable. Append random token prefix to push KV eviction -> perplexity spikes then slowly returns. Happens only when batch_size >= 12.
ashwin: Interesting. Which kernel are you on? v2 or v3?
maya: v2_gpu_kernel_default. Switching to v3 seemed to reduce CPU tail but didn't fully remove drift.
jen: Any difference between linear vs NTK RoPE modes?
maya: Linear RoPE is stable. NTK and YARN both show the oscillation but NTK worse.
liam: Could be head/KV dimension aliasing. Mixtral variant uses heads=40, kv_dim=160; if our KV cache packing aligns poorly under large batch consolidation we might be overwriting prefix states during eviction.
zoe: Do we have profiler traces? perf-bot, can you attach the latest trace for the failing job?
perf-bot: Attached flamegraph: /artifacts/2065432100/mixtral-ntk-evict-flame.html
ashwin: From traces: lots of memcpy spikes during KV compaction + small-allreduce at end of batch. Batching heuristic consolidates requests which increases effective seq_len variance, triggering early/generic eviction path.
jen: Quick experiment suggestion: 1) set batching.prefer_consolidation=false 2) eviction.window=2048 (was 1024) 3) run kernel v3 with small-kv-alloc patch.
maya: Running test now, config snippet I'm using:
```
model: mixtral-8x
rope: ntk
batching:
  prefer_consolidation: false
  max_batch: 20
kv:
  eviction_window: 2048
kernel: v3
```
liam: Also try forcing kv_alignment=64 and head_kv_stride=1 to see if packing artifacts change.
zoe: FYI I ran a quick inner-loop on a dev box: disabling consolidation removed the spike but latency tail increased ~8ms. So tradeoff.
ashwin: If disabling consolidation fixes correctness, we can implement a safety-fastpath: detect NTK rope + head_kv mismatch -> avoid consolidation for those combos.
jen: We should also add a regression test in perf harness: synthetic longctx prefix insertion and randomized eviction to catch drift.
maya: Results: after disabling consolidation + eviction_window=2048 perplexity stabilized across 10 runs. We'll do a broader run on dedicated capacity later.
liam: Great. Can someone open a perf bug with config snapshots + attached traces? I'll own kernel-side follow-up.
zoe: I'll file the bug: PERF-1284, attaching traces and test configs.
maya: Thanks — next steps: 1) infra triage (liam) 2) add harness test (jen) 3) short-term hotfix (disable consolidation for affected combos) (ashwin)
liam: ack. Also let's evaluate impact on throughput for high-concurrency services before rollout.
maya: Yep, posting results here after the dedicated runs :thumbsup:
